site.title: Memories
site.lede: Everything worth keeping, filed by the year it happened in. Newest at the top — scroll down and the years run backwards.
site.quote: Time moves in one direction, memory in another.
site.author: William Gibson

2026.quote: We do not remember days, we remember moments.
2026.author: Cesare Pavese

2025.quote: Memory is the diary that we all carry about with us.
2025.author: Oscar Wilde

2024.quote: Nothing is ever really lost to us as long as we remember it.
2024.author: L. M. Montgomery

2023.quote: The past beats inside me like a second heart.
2023.author: John Banville
